title: Recognize `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/test-rust.ps1 [--phase …]` as a test stage, as the scripts/test-rust.sh form already is
outcome: Recognize `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/test-rust.ps1 [--phase …]` as a test stage, as the scripts/test-rust.sh form already is
acceptance: A focused or full launcher stage whose argv is `pwsh` or `pwsh.exe` with `-NoProfile -File scripts/test-rust.ps1` and optional `--phase <name>` arguments is recognized as a Rust test stage with the same rules, scope and safety limits as the existing scripts/test-rust.sh recognition; other PowerShell argv shapes (inline -Command, other scripts, extra pre/post commands) stay unrecognized.

A recognized pwsh stage records passed, failed (including a crash without a libtest summary) and its counts exactly as the .sh stage does, so native verification is granted or refused on the outcome, not the argv.

Behavioural tests cover the recognized pwsh form (pass, normal fail, crash-shaped fail) and representative unrecognized PowerShell forms, using the existing verification preparation path; no text-pinning tests.
